result.title: EventSSM: Causal Spatial-State Modelling for Asynchronous Events Event-Depth Estimation
result.summary: Event cameras report asynchronous brightness changes, yet metric-depth supervision is typically available only at sparsely sampled reference timestamps. Aggregating events into frame-like representations simplifies learning but can obscure the fine-grained temporal structure of the original event stream. We introduce EventSSM, a causal spatial-state framework for event-associated metric-depth estimation using a recurrent memory updated by chronological event packets. To bridge asynchronous predictions and frame-time supervision, predicted event depths are geometrically transported using calibrated camera poses and differentiably rendered at reference timestamps. Benchmark evaluations demonstrate improvements over established event-depth methods across multiple depth-error measures. Controlled ablations further examine cross-modal initialization, temporal recurrence, individual state, readout, and supervision components, and packet subdivision. Together, these findings establish EventSSM as an effective framework for causal event-associated metric-depth estimation, combining persistent spatial context with physically timed state retention.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 EventSSM：以按时间顺序到达的事件包更新循环记忆，因果地维持空间状态来做事件相机度量深度估计，并用相机位姿几何变换与可微渲染把异步深度预测对齐到参考时刻的监督。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「持续潜在状态 + 分组增量更新 + 状态/读出分项消融」可为 LVR 中 latent 状态的维护与按证据流更新、以及异步预测与稀疏监督的对齐提供可供核查的线索，但任务本身是稠密深度感知，不涉及语言推理。
